If you have questions or suggestions related to my behavior, please file an issue against the [openshift-eng/jira-lifecycle-plugin](https://github.com/openshift-eng/jira-lifecycle-plugin/issues/new) repository.

## Walkthrough The pull request adds Dynamic Resource Allocation support, connection limiting, metrics and pprof handling, lossless CNI conflist processing, expanded Kubernetes permissions, pinned CI actions, updated Go/OpenShift build inputs, qualified test images, and minor logging and event-format changes. ### Changes **DRA resource integration** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**DRA client implementation**
`pkg/draclient/*`|Adds cached ResourceClaim and ResourceSlice resolution for regular and extended DRA allocations, with comprehensive mapping and error-handling tests.| |**DRA delegate integration**
`pkg/k8sclient/*`, `pkg/kubeletclient/*`|Merges DRA-derived resources with kubelet resource data and adds integration coverage for delegate resolution and hybrid allocations.| |**DRA permissions and usage**
`deployments/*`, `docs/how-to-use.md`, `go.mod`|Adds DRA RBAC permissions, the `nad` CRD short name, updated DRA usage examples, and newer Go/Kubernetes dependencies.| **Connection limiting and diagnostics** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Connection limit configuration and enforcement**
`cmd/multus-daemon/main.go`, `pkg/server/types.go`, `e2e/templates/*`, `e2e/test-connection-limit.sh`, `.github/workflows/kind-e2e.yml`|Adds `connectionLimit` configuration, listener limiting, and an e2e workload and test step.| |**Metrics and pprof server**
`cmd/multus-daemon/main.go`|Uses a dedicated mux for `/metrics` and conditionally exposes selected pprof endpoints.| **CNI configuration preservation** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Lossless conflist processing**
`pkg/types/conf.go`, `pkg/types/conf_test.go`, `pkg/multus/multus.go`|Rebuilds conflist bytes from raw plugin data and injects `cniVersion` without dropping nested fields or appended plugins.| |**Delegate contract cleanup**
`pkg/types/types.go`|Removes the stored libcni configuration-list field and narrows conditional device-ID sorting.| **Workflow and platform maintenance** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Pinned GitHub Actions**
`.github/workflows/*`|Replaces floating action tags with commit-SHA references while preserving workflow inputs and conditions.| |**Go and OpenShift build inputs**
`go.mod`, `.ci-operator.yaml`, `Dockerfile.*`|Updates Go and Kubernetes dependencies and switches builder and runtime images to OpenShift 5.0.| |**Qualified e2e images**
`e2e/templates/*`|Uses fully qualified registry paths for Alpine, CentOS, and Ubuntu images.| |**Event, logging, and readiness behavior**
`cmd/cert-approver/main.go`, `pkg/logging/logging.go`, `pkg/server/server.go`, `pkg/multus/multus.go`|Updates CSR warning formatting, adds `Warningf`, strips readiness indicators when configured, and prefixes aggregated delete errors.| **Estimated code review effort:** 5 (Critical) | ~120 minutes **Possibly related PRs** - [openshift/multus-cni#332](https://github.com/openshift/multus-cni/pull/332): Changes the CSR denial event formatting and overlaps on Go/OpenShift build updates. - [openshift/multus-cni#333](https://github.com/openshift/multus-cni/pull/333): Combines the CSR event format fix with the Go 1.26 and Kubernetes/OpenShift rebase. **Suggested reviewers:** `s1061123`, `bpickard22` --- > [!IMPORTANT] > ## Pre-merge checks failed > > Please resolve all errors before merging. Addressing warnings is optional. ### ❌ Failed checks (2 errors, 2 warnings, 1 inconclusive) | Check name | Status | Explanation | Resolution | | :----------------------------------------------: | :------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Container-Privileges | ❌ Error | Changed manifests include privileged: true, hostNetwork, hostPID, and SYS_ADMIN (e.g. e2e/templates/many-pods.yml.j2, deployments/*daemonset*.yml). | Remove or explicitly justify these privileged/host-namespace settings, or scope them out of the manifest diff. | | No-Sensitive-Data-In-Logs | ❌ Error | New DRA logs print pod/node names and resource identifiers in debug/verbose paths, which can expose internal hostnames/tenant data. | Redact node/pod/claim identifiers or replace object dumps with sanitized fields before logging. | | Docstring Coverage | ⚠️ Warning | Docstring coverage is 60.00% which is insufficient. The required threshold is 80.00%. | Write docstrings for the functions missing them to satisfy the coverage threshold. | | Ipv6 And Disconnected Network Test Compatibility | ⚠️ Warning | New e2e coverage runs `test-connection-limit.sh`, which creates pods from `image: centos:8` (public registry), so it won't work in disconnected CI. | Use an internal/mirrored image for the many-pods template (or preload it locally), or mark the test `[Skipped:Disconnected]`. | | Title check | ❓ Inconclusive | The title is too generic and date-based; it doesn't clearly describe the main change in the PR. | Rename it to summarize the primary change, e.g. adding DRA support and OpenShift 5.0/Go 1.26 updates. |
✅ Passed checks (10 passed) | Check name | Status | Explanation | | :--------------------------------------------: | :------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | | Linked Issues check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped because no linked issues were found for this pull request. | | Out of Scope Changes check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped because no linked issues were found for this pull request. | | Stable And Deterministic Test Names | ✅ Passed | Reviewed all changed Ginkgo titles and table-entry names; none interpolate runtime data or include changing identifiers. | | Test Structure And Quality | ✅ Passed | The new Ginkgo tests are isolated with BeforeEach/AfterEach, use fake clients instead of cluster ops, and don’t add indefinite waits or resource leaks. | | Microshift Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | No new Ginkgo e2e specs were added under e2e/, and the new test code uses only core Kubernetes/resource APIs—not MicroShift-unsupported OpenShift APIs. | | Single Node Openshift (Sno) Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | The new e2e coverage only creates a 6-replica Deployment and waits for readiness; it doesn’t require distinct nodes, HA failover, or topology checks. | | Topology-Aware Scheduling Compatibility | ✅ Passed | No new topology-sensitive scheduling constraints were introduced; the modified manifests only add arch selectors, tolerations, RBAC/CRD changes, and test replica counts. | | Ote Binary Stdout Contract | ✅ Passed | No new process-level stdout writes were introduced; the added suite entrypoints are boilerplate only, and runtime logs are stderr-bound. | | No-Weak-Crypto | ✅ Passed | HEAD only changes .ci-operator.yaml and two Dockerfiles; the patch contains no MD5/SHA1/DES/RC4/3DES/Blowfish/ECB or secret-compare code. | | Description Check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped - CodeRabbit’s high-level summary is enabled. |

pkg/k8sclient/k8sclient_test.go (1)
`1790-1795`: _📐 Maintainability & Code Quality_ | _🔵 Trivial_ | _⚡ Quick win_ **These "DRA" tests don't exercise the DRA path.** `getKubernetesDelegate` only enters the DRA branch when `resourceMap == nil`. Here (and in the two contexts below) a non-nil empty `resourceMap` is passed in, so the DRA lookup is skipped and the created `ResourceClaim`/`ResourceSlice` objects are never consulted — the assertions pass trivially even if DRA were broken. - Line 1790-1791 (`GetNetworkDelegates` … DRA-enabled pod) - Line 1904-1905 (`TryLoadPodDelegates` … DRA resources) - Line 2112-2113 (`getNetDelegate` … DRA resources) Pass `nil` for `resourceMap` (as the context at Line 1609 does) and stub `getResourceClientFunc`, then assert the DRA device ID lands under the NAD `resourceName` key.
🤖 Prompt for AI Agents ``` Verify each finding against current code. Fix only still-valid issues, skip the rest with a brief reason, keep changes minimal, and validate. In `@pkg/k8sclient/k8sclient_test.go` around lines 1790 - 1795, Update the three DRA test contexts around GetNetworkDelegates, TryLoadPodDelegates, and getNetDelegate to pass nil instead of an empty resourceMap, and stub getResourceClientFunc so the DRA lookup executes.
